q: Who does the lasers for Coachella?
a: In 2025 Polar Productions supplied lasers to six Coachella stages and to Stagecoach, using Kvant projectors run on Pangolin BEYOND and FB4. Selected units on the main stage, Gobi and Mojave carried PASS hardware for audience scanning.

q: How many lasers does EDC Kinetic Field use?
a: More than 30 high-power laser systems ran on Kinetic Field in 2014, supplied by Lasertainment. Nobody has published a Kinetic Field projector list for recent years.

q: What lasers did Illenium use at SoFi Stadium?
a: For the Trilogy shows on February 2 and 3, 2024, the software maker's case study lists 147 laser systems totaling more than 4,000 W, mostly Kvant Atom 42s plus a 270 W Kvant EPIC. Brad Kellogg designed it and Bill Loftus programmed it, with Polar Productions.

q: Do lasers at Sphere Las Vegas hit the screen?
a: For Illenium's Odyssey at Sphere, 16 Kvant Atom 58 W units were placed to interact with the screen and four projectors on the lower mezzanine served as beam terminations. The lasers were zoned so beams looked symmetrical from every angle.

q: Do outdoor laser shows need FAA permission?
a: The FAA does not permit shows, but under Advisory Circular 70-1B an operator files Form 7140-1 at least 30 days ahead and gets a letter saying the FAA objects or does not. ILDA advises its members to file 90 days ahead.

q: Why do lasers go over the crowd in the US but into it in Europe?
a: In the US, beams normally stay 3 m above and 2.5 m beside the audience unless the FDA has approved audience scanning in the show's variance. Europe varies: the UK leaves the duty with the organizer under health and safety law, while the Nordic regulators recommend against audience exposure altogether.

q: Who won the ILDA Awards in 2026?
a: At the 2026 ceremony in Salzburg, Visual Sensation won the Nightclub/Festival category with Tranceformation 2026, Kvant won Permanent Installation and LightStream won the new Sporting Show category. Richard Gonsalves received the Career Achievement Award.
